subject.title: Feature request: Shareable cron job templates

question: Should ClawHub become a first-class registry and installer for recurring OpenClaw jobs, or should shared automations remain skills or plugins whose schedules users create explicitly in OpenClaw?
rationale: The request adds both a new catalog object and a remote-to-local recurring-execution path; current repository contracts do not decide its artifact model, installation authority, or security lifecycle.

options.title: Keep Scheduling Explicit
options.body: Permit skills or bundle plugins to include reusable cron examples, but require users to inspect and create each scheduled job through OpenClaw's existing local workflow.

options.title: Design Automation Packages
options.body: Create a dedicated reviewed manifest and catalog with schedule preview, permission disclosure, explicit confirmation, moderation, versioning, installation, update, disable, and removal behavior.

options.title: Defer The Catalog
options.body: Keep the issue open as product research until OpenClaw exposes an approved import and lifecycle API for recurring jobs.

recommendation.title: Keep Scheduling Explicit
recommendation.body: Permit skills or bundle plugins to include reusable cron examples, but require users to inspect and create each scheduled job through OpenClaw's existing local workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-level product vision is the strongest available authority for choosing whether this becomes a first-class ClawHub surface.
